Professor '''David Lyth''' (21 June 1940) is a researcher in particle [[cosmology]] at the [[University of Lancaster]]. He has published over 165 papers as well as two books on [[early universe cosmology]] and [[cosmological inflation]].<ref name=lythwebsite>{{Cite web | url=http://davidhlyth.co.uk | title=David Lyth - Physics and fiddling| access-date=2024-04-15}}</ref>

==Research==
He is noted for his work in the area of ''inflation model building'' and the ''observational consequences of models of inflation''. In 1997, he discovered the [[Lyth bound]] which relates the tensor-scalar ratio of perturbations in the [[Cosmic microwave background|CMB]] to the variation of the inflaton field during inflation.<ref>{{cite journal |title=The Lyth Bound and the end of inflation|journal=Journal of Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics|volume=2006|issue=8|pages=004|doi=10.1088/1475-7516/2006/08/004|year=2006|last1=Easther|first1=Richard|last2=Kinney|first2=William H.|last3=Powell|first3=Brian A.|arxiv=astro-ph/0601276|bibcode=2006JCAP...08..004E|s2cid=50810956|url=https://cds.cern.ch/record/921729}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |title=The Lyth bound revisited|journal=Journal of Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics|volume=2005|issue=5|pages=008|doi=10.1088/1475-7516/2005/05/008|year=2005|last1=Efstathiou|first1=George|last2=Mack|first2=Katherine J.|arxiv=astro-ph/0503360|bibcode=2005JCAP...05..008E|s2cid=14666717}}</ref> He proposed the [[Curvaton|Curvaton Scenario]] in 2001, with [[David Wands]] of [[Portsmouth University]].<ref name=lythwebsite/>
He was awarded the [[Fred Hoyle Medal and Prize]] in 2012.

==Books==
*''Cosmological Inflation and Large Scale Structure'' (2000), with [[Andrew Liddle]], {{ISBN|0-521-57598-2}}
*''The Primordial Density Perturbation'' (2009), with [[Andrew Liddle]], {{ISBN|0-521-82849-X}}
*''Cosmology for Physicists'' (2016) 
*''The History of the Universe'' (2016)
